agent-manifest.description: Deterministic patient store keyed by verified identity: enrollment records, insurance plan, and the currently active patient for the session. Isolated per patient — no record is readable across patients.

offer.body: Confirms whether a caller matches an enrolled patient (name + DOB or member id); the verdict the orchestrator uses to settle verification.
The verified patient's record for this session (id, name, insurance plan). Consumed by every agent that must act for the right patient.
Patient records and appointments are keyed to the verified patient and are never readable across patients (services/registry.py).

use.body: Accepts the verified-patient assertion from the orchestrator; state is updated only for the identity it verified this turn.
